verdicts.reason: A blows the small sparkle up into a huge white star that dominates the middle of the banner and becomes the main focal point. Its symptom list is also re-wrapped badly ('Shortness of breath Dry cough' and 'Sore throat Headache' each run two items together on one line), and the hashtag has shrunk to a tiny pill. B's list reads better and the CTA sits with it, but 'Sore throat Headache' is still merged and the text block is cramped against the edges. B also moves #FLATTENTHECURVE below the doctor as a button-like pill, which breaks the reading order, and puts an oversized star in the bottom-left corner, so B is only slightly less broken.
